gloss: to be useful, to be helpful

definitions.gloss: to be useful, to be helpful
definitions.explanation: To serve a purpose or provide benefit. A compound expression meaning 'to stand in a role.'

examples.japanese: この{辞書|じしょ}は{役|やく}に{立|た}つ。
{何|なに}かお{役|やく}に{立|た}てることはありますか。
examples.english: Is there anything I can help you with?

examples.japanese: {役|やく}に{立|た}たない{情報|じょうほう}。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xが{役|やく}に{立|た}つ (X is useful) / Xの{役|やく}に{立|た}つ (be useful for X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {役|やく}に{立|た}っている = 'is being useful.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{役|やく}に{立|た}つ (is useful)
・{役|やく}に{立|た}たない (is useless)
・お{役|やく}に{立|た}てる (can be of use—potential, humble)
・{役|やく}に{立|た}てて{嬉|うれ}しい (glad to be of help)

COMPOUND: {役|やく} (role) + に + {立|た}つ (to stand) = 'to stand in a useful role'

POLITE VARIATIONS:
・お{役|やく}に{立|た}てれば{幸|さいわ}いです (I'd be happy if I can be of help)
・お{役|やく}に{立|た}てて{光栄|こうえい}です (It's an honor to be of service)
